entries.name: Button
entries.summary: A simple button control
entries.details:
This is the basic clickable thing you use for actions. It can show text, change colors,
and raise `Click` when the user presses it.

entries.name: ScrollBar
entries.summary: A simple scrollbar for vertical or horizontal scrolling.
entries.details:
Drop this on a panel or content surface when you want a basic scroll thumb. It works best
when you hook it up to the content element and the visible viewport, then let it report a
current value as the user drags.

entries.name: SetContentSize
entries.summary: Updates the total scrollable content size.

params.name: size
params.text: Total size of the content in scroll direction.

entries.name: SetOrientation
entries.summary: Chooses whether the scrollbar runs vertically or horizontally.

params.name: orientation
params.text: The direction the thumb should travel.

entries.name: SetScrollTarget

params.name: target

entries.summary: Sets the thumb color.

params.text: A minimum-sized thumb; values below 1 are clamped to 1.

params.name: value

entries.summary: Controls whether the TextBox participates in hit testing.

By default a TextBox is hit-test visible so it receives mouse events. Call
`SetHitTestVisible(false)` to opt out and allow events to pass through.

params.name: value

entries.summary: Enables basic text wrapping.

params.name: value
params.text: `true` to wrap long lines, `false` to keep a single line.

entries.name: TextBox
entries.summary: A single-line (or wrapping) text input control.
entries.details:
`TextBox` renders editable text, manages a caret, and fires `TextChanged` when the content
changes. It supports read-only mode, basic wrapping, and appearance options (colors, font
size, padding). Use this control for simple text input inside layouts.

entries.name: TextBox
